item.title: High-tech Israeli medical firm opens Manatee facility, plans 100 jobs
item.description: A fast-growing medtech firm based in Israel recently celebrated the opening of its new U.S. headquarters in north Manatee County. The group of officials and business leaders at the opening event, held Feb. 2, included Florida Lt. Gov. Jay Collins. The firm, Ossio, makes metal-free fixation implants out of a proprietary material that allows for bone regeneration. item.title: USF ranks among top 20 public universities for patent production
item.description: The University of South Florida has once again reaffirmed its reputation as an emerging research institution, earning a place for the 13th consecutive year among the top 20 public universities for producing U.S. utility patents. The National Academy of Investors released its annual rankings today, placing USF No. 18 among all U.S. public research universities for the 81 new patents the university secured in 2025. item.description: All Glass & Windows, a Sarasota-based window and door business, has acquired Sarasota Glass & Mirror. item.title: Aldi-anchored center in Pasco County sells for $6.4 million
item.description: Oakview Plaza, an Aldi-anchored shopping center in Zephyrhills, has sold. New York-based New Hyde Park Food Corp. bought the center, at 38923 County Road 54. It paid $6.4 million. The Pasco County shopping center was built in 1990 and has close to 47,000 square feet of retail space. According to the listing from Franklin Street, which brokered the deal, the Aldi has $2 million in company-funded upgrades coming. item.title: Sarasota cybersecurity firm raises $20M, plans to scale
item.description: A Sarasota-based cybersecurity firm recently closed its Series C funding round, securing $20 million. The latest capital raise for Nucleus Security was led by venture capital firm Delta-v Capita, headquartered in Denver,.Nucleus Security specializes in exposure management. item.title: Suncoast Credit Union announces merger, would grow to over $21B
item.description: The largest credit union in Florida is about to get bigger: Tampa-based Suncoast Credit Union, with $19.68 billion in assets, announced a merger Friday with Launch Credit Union, based in Brevard County. Launch, serving Brevard and Volusia counties out of its Merritt Island headquarters, has more than $1.43 billion in assets. item.description: Forbes released its 2026 “Best Large Employers” list this week, and it includes a handful of organizations from the region.
